name: Ben Lambert A Full Course in Econometrics - Undergraduate Level
desc: Ben Lambert's complete undergraduate econometrics course (parts 1 and 2 merged). Part 1 covers estimators and their properties, deriving OLS and BLUE, the Gauss-Markov assumptions and their violations (omitted variable bias, reverse causality, measurement error, heteroskedasticity, serial correlation, multicollinearity), hypothesis testing, F tests, diagnostic tests, weighted least squares and feasible GLS, instrumental variables and two stage least squares, and time series foundations from stationarity through unit roots and cointegration. Part 2 continues with ARMA and error correction models, pooled cross sections and panel data with first differences, fixed and random effects, discrete choice models with logit and probit, maximum likelihood estimation and the likelihood ratio, Wald, and score tests, simultaneous equation models, and Monte Carlo simulation.
